claims.claim: The Königsberg multigraph has four odd-degree vertices (3, 3, 5, 3), so it has neither an Euler trail nor an Euler circuit.
claims.locator: Euler Archive E53; written 1735 and published 1741; Commentarii academiae scientiarum Petropolitanae 8, pp. 128–140
claims.notes: Degree sequence checked against the seven-bridge multigraph; Euler trail criterion stated explicitly.

claims.claim: Erdős and Rényi published On random graphs I in 1959.
Watts and Strogatz introduced the small-world rewiring model in 1998.
Barabási and Albert described growth plus preferential attachment as mechanisms for scale-free degree distributions.
